description: Inland Electronic Navigational Charts is a dataset listed in BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) on geodata.bts.gov, an open geospatial hub of the U.S. transportation atlas, published or maintained by United States Army Corp of Engineers (USACE). The Inland Electronic Navigational Charts (IENC) dataset is updated bi-monthly by the US Army Corps (USACE)/Army Geospatial Center (AGC), and part of U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT)/Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD). There is a partial delivery on the 1st and 15th business day of a month. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of United States Army Corp of Engineers (USACE). Its keywords are inlandWaters, USA, National, Continental United States, NTAD, National Transportation Atlas Database, Transportation, Atlas. The hub shows 2026-09-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Users should be aware that the IENCs reflect best available information at the time the data was collected. These data products are subject to change.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ntad-geodata-bts-gov-hub.
